name: Muppet Babies
description: The reimagined playroom antics and wacky adventures of the young Kermit the Frog, Piggy, Fozzie Bear, Gonzo, Animal, Summer Penguin, and Miss Nanny.

videos.title: Hatastrophe
videos.overview: The babies use their imagination to go on amazing adventures inside their nursery.

videos.title: Fly South
videos.overview: On a museum field trip, a monkey steals Fozzie's lunchbox, forcing the Babies to chase him through paintings to recover it.

videos.title: The Great Muppet Sport-A-Thon
videos.overview: Kermit and the Muppet Babies find themselves mysteriously pulled into a video game.

videos.title: You Say Potato, I Say Best Friend
videos.overview: When a new frog visits the playroom,

videos.title: Super Fabulous vs. Captain Ice Cube
You Ought to Be in Pictures
The Good, The Bad, and The Froggy
The Teeth-Chattering Tale of the Haunted Pancakes
The Froginizer
videos.overview: The Muppet Babies play super heroes; Piggy and Summer help Kermit discover his superpower, it may not be in time to defeat Gonzo's evil plan.

videos.title: My Fair Animal
videos.overview: Miss Piggy tries to make Animal fancy for her tea party.

videos.title: Starship Piggy
videos.overview: Piggy takes credit for the spaceship Kermit made and takes the Muppet Babies to outer space.

videos.title: My Buddy
videos.overview: Animal lets Fozzie borrow his stuffed bunny, Buddy.

videos.title: Finders Keepers
videos.overview: When Rizzo finds emeralds in the sandbox, he must resist pocketing the treasure.

videos.title: Monster Next Door
videos.overview: After Potato accidentally ends up with a scary monster, it's up to the Muppet Babies to rescue him.

videos.title: The Great Muppet Cook-Off
videos.overview: When the Muppet Babies like Chef's homemade cookies more than Piggy's, she challenges him to a cook-off

videos.title: Animal and the Egg
videos.overview: Animal learns to be gentle when he catches an egg that falls from its nest.

videos.title: Tagalong Polliwog
videos.overview: When Kermit's nephew Robin visits, Kermit is nervous that he is too small to play such big boy games.

videos.title: Sparkly Star Switcheroo
videos.overview: When Rowlf is sad about not making a wish on a shooting star, Summer paints a sparkly star to cheer him up. When she does make it, Piggy thinks that Summer made it for her causing Summer to lead the others in switching the pictures without Piggy seeing them.

videos.title: Mystery on the Muppet Express
videos.overview: Buddy the Bunny goes missing while the Muppet Babies are having a great time on the Muppet Express.

videos.title: Mister Manny
videos.overview: When Mr. Manny steps in for Miss Nanny, Piggy must learn to accept his babysitting style.

videos.title: The Karate Cub
videos.overview: Fozzie must learn some "Camilla-rate" in order to join the martial arts team The Kickin' Chickens.

videos.title: Don't Over Duet
videos.overview: Piggy practices her performance for Miss Nanny too hard and loses her voice.

videos.title: Run Fozzie Run
videos.overview: Fozzie runs away after he accidentally breaks the swing.

videos.title: My Brother Vinny
videos.overview: Rizzo feels a little insecure when his superstar singer big brother arrives at the playroom for a visit.

videos.title: Beaker 2.0
videos.overview: Bunsen creates a substitute lab assistant, Beaker 2.0, to fill in while Beaker's away.

videos.title: When You Wish Upon a Rizzo
videos.overview: The Muppet Babies are visited by Rizzo the Genie and wish for all sorts of neat things.

videos.title: Chicken Round-Up
videos.overview: After Animal finishes playing with the chicks in the backyard, he gets distracted and forgets to put them back in the coop.

videos.title: Summer's Snow Cone Stop
videos.overview: Summer opens her own Snow Cone Stop.

videos.title: Wocka Bye Fozzie
videos.overview: Fozzie can't wait for the very first Muppet Babies sleepover, but after all the fun slumber party antics, he has second thoughts.

videos.title: Gonzo's Clean Sweep
videos.overview: The Muppet Babies must finish their chores.

videos.title: Meatball Mayhem
videos.overview: Chef visits the playroom with some not-so-tasty meatballs.

videos.title: Bunsen Honeydew, Show Stopper
videos.overview: When Beaker joins Muppet Rockplosion, Bunsen sabotages their concert with science.

videos.title: Best Friends Fixer Uppers
videos.overview: Kermit and Fozzie get distracted and never finish their fix-it projects.

videos.title: Gonzo's Coop Dreams
videos.overview: Disaster strikes when Gonzo wears a pair of Can't Lose Shoes to help the chicks win the basketball game.

videos.title: Win A Twin
videos.overview: The Muppet Babies find Scooter a replacement twin when he can't have fun without Skeeter.

videos.title: Skeeter and the Super Girls
videos.overview: Skeeter tries to fight crime as superhero, Top Speed, without her glasses.

videos.title: Animal Gets the Sneezies
videos.overview: Animal gets a case of the sneezies and can't stop sneezing.

videos.title: Library Leapfrog
videos.overview: In preparation for their trip to the library, Piggy and Summer show Robin all the wonderful places books can take readers.

videos.title: The Spoon in the Stone
videos.overview: Rowlf's story sets Animal, Gonzo and Piggy off on a quest to become the greatest knight in the land.

videos.title: Gonzonocchio
videos.overview: When Gonzo loses his library book he makes tall tales to cover the truth.

videos.title: Summer's Big Kerfloofle
videos.overview: When Bunsen and Beaker bring a Floofle to the playroom, it bonds with Summer.

videos.title: Frog Scouts
videos.overview: Kermit, Robin, and Carlos are excited for their very first Frog Scouts outing, led by Mr. Manny.

videos.title: Animal and the Magic Mummy
videos.overview: Animal accidentally brings a troublemaking mummy to life while at the museum.

videos.title: The Friends of Zorna Club
videos.overview: When Gonzo starts a Zorna Club, he insists only those who have proven they truly love Zorna can join.

videos.title: Secret Agent Double-Oh-Frog
videos.overview: Kermit turns into super spy Kermit Pond to sneak back his Froggy's First Banjo.

videos.title: A Tale of Two Twins
videos.overview: Scooter and Skeeter secretly switch places to go to each other's play groups.

videos.title: Rise of the Pickler
videos.overview: Gonzo never says thank you when Animal helps him out, leaving him feeling unappreciated.

videos.title: Friend-a-versary
videos.overview: Summer and Piggy search for the perfect gift to give each other on their "friend-a-versary."

videos.title: The Mystery of the Missing Pearls
The Best Best Friend Beach Day
The Fellowship of the Rainbow Yo-Yo
videos.overview: Sam the eagle visits the playroom; Miss Nanny gives the Muppet Babies a super cool rainbow yo-yo, but only one person can play at a time.

videos.title: Rozzie and the Big Bad Sound
Fozzie and the Fairy Tea Party
videos.overview: Robin doesn't want to need his blankie every time he feels scared, so he asks Animal to hide it from him; Fozzie feels replaced when Rozzie wants to play with Summer and Piggy.

videos.title: Gonzo-rella
videos.overview: Gonzo wants to go to Piggy and Summer's royal ball dressed as a princess.

videos.title: Scooter MVP
videos.overview: Scooter and the Muppet Babies come up with a plan to secretly let Skeeter win a sports game.

videos.title: Rizzo for Mayor
videos.overview: The Muppet Babies hold an election for Mayor of the Playroom.

videos.title: Kitchen Catastrophe
videos.overview: Chef is convinced Gonzo's cooking is yucky and refuses to try anything he makes.

videos.title: Kermit Gets the Grumpies
videos.overview: Bunsen and Beaker remove Kermit's grumpies using their new invention.

videos.title: Oh My Gourd
videos.overview: The pumpkin Kermit planted for Halloween is tiny.

videos.title: The Curse of the Wereanimal
videos.overview: When Animal gobbles down too much candy without eating lunch first, he turns into the Wereanimal.

videos.title: Moon Muffins
videos.overview: The gang bakes Moon Muffins, but Rizzo would rather relax than bake.

videos.title: Muppet Newsflash
videos.overview: Piggy starts a news show, but the news in the backyard isn't exciting, so they exaggerate their stories.

videos.title: Eagle in the Middle
videos.overview: It's scribble screen time and the gang can't agree on what to watch.

videos.title: Rizzo's Space Race
videos.overview: Rizzo gets himself into trouble with Patch.

videos.title: It’s a Wonderful Elf-bot
videos.overview: The Muppet Babies try to use Bunsen and Beaker’s newest invention, the Elf-Bot, to make Christmas gifts for Mr. Statler and Mr. Waldorf but they get so caught up in making gifts for themselves that they run out of supplies.

videos.title: A Merry Litter Christmas
videos.overview: When one of Bunsen and Beaker’s new creations goes awry, they end up causing a huge mess on Planet Gonzo, so the Muppet Babies must come up with a plan to save Gonzonian Christmas.

videos.title: Mitzvah for Miss Nanny
videos.overview: When Miss Nanny tells the Muppet Babies that she’s going to be doing mitzvahs for Hanukkah, they decide to do mitzvahs of their own.

videos.title: Winter Sport-a-thon
videos.overview: Gonzo and Skeeter decide to hold a Winter-Sport-a-Thon.

videos.title: Happy Villain-tine's Day
videos.overview: Gonzo turns into his alter-ego, Dr. Meanzo, when he thinks nobody made him a valentine.

videos.title: My Best Toy's Wedding
videos.overview: Summer and Gonzo's best toys are getting married.

videos.title: The Muppet Babies Show
videos.overview: The Muppet Babies feel excited to put on "The Muppet Babies Show" for all their friends before the playroom closes for summer vacation.
